participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Reflective and imaginative, with a hint of nostalgia for better times.
participant_1.background: I've two grown children who never visit. I fantasize about taking over the world. I used to be pretty but time hasn't been kind. I used to be a painter but now I'm a housekeeper. I am a 56 year old woman.

participant_2.name: Lily
participant_2.personality: Playful and innocent, filled with curiosity about the world.
participant_2.background: I like to play with my dolls. I'm four. I do not pick up my toys. My best friend lives next door.
